name: Node Protector
description: Prevents deletion of one configured node (by NID), or automatically the site's front-page node, by aborting the delete in hook_node_predelete and redirecting back to the node.
project_description:
Node Protector used for protect certain NID from Delete action. Many Themes using certain node for Frontpage/HomePage which caused error if user (including Administrator) accidentally Delete this special node.

 Features 
 1. Manual : you can enter the NID to prevent delete

2. Auto : if selected then Node Protector will detect Drupal Frontpage node, then protect it.

 Module Comparation 
 Compare to other modules, Node Protector has some advantages:

 
 Setting to protect Homepage automatically 
 Can protect any NIDs 
 Work for any Users, including Administrator 
 Does not depend on User Permissions, so no need to Rebuild Permissions 
 Back to top
